name: Kettlebell Swing
steps: Stand with feet a little wider than hips, kettlebell on the floor just in front.
Hinge at the hips, grip the handle with both hands and hike it back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and stand tall so the bell floats up to chest height.
Let the bell fall back, then hinge again as your forearms meet your thighs.
To finish, hinge and park the bell on the floor in front of you.
cues: Hinge at the hips, not a squat
Hips drive the bell, arms just guide it
Breathe out sharply as you stand tall

common_mistakes.mistake: Lifting the bell with the arms
common_mistakes.fix: Keep arms loose and let the hip snap move the bell
Push hips back with only a soft bend in the knees
Finish standing straight with glutes and stomach tight
